data.title: Community Meeting Scheduled
data.description: A community meeting has been scheduled for next Saturday at 2 PM in the community hall. All residents are requested to attend to discuss upcoming development projects.

data.title: New Water Supply Schedule
data.description: Starting from next week, water supply will be available from 6 AM to 8 AM and 6 PM to 8 PM daily. Please store water accordingly.

data.title: Health Camp Announcement
data.description: A free health camp will be organized on January 25th from 9 AM to 4 PM at the community center. Free checkups for blood pressure, diabetes, and general health will be available.

data.title: Garbage Collection Update
data.description: Garbage collection schedule has been updated. Collection will happen on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings. Please keep your bins outside by 7 AM.

data.title: Road Repair Notice
data.description: Road repair work will begin on Main Street from January 20th to January 25th. Please use alternative routes during this period. We apologize for any inconvenience.

data.title: Community Cleanup Drive
data.description: Join us for a community cleanup drive this Sunday at 7 AM. We'll be cleaning the park and surrounding areas. Refreshments will be provided.

data.title: Electricity Maintenance
data.description: Scheduled electricity maintenance on January 18th from 9 AM to 12 PM. Power supply will be interrupted during this time. Please plan accordingly.

data.title: New Community Library Opening
data.description: We're excited to announce the opening of our new community library on January 22nd. It will be open from 9 AM to 6 PM daily. All residents are welcome!
